categories.question: You can follow one coastline for the afternoon. Which one draws you in?

outcomes.name: A black pebble beach
outcomes.description: Short strip of smooth black pebbles with white sea foam and slate-blue water

outcomes.name: A white cliff walk
outcomes.description: Miniature windswept green headland with bright white chalk cliffs and a narrow path

outcomes.name: A red mangrove creek
outcomes.description: Winding narrow creek between red mangrove trees on arching roots

outcomes.name: A crescent of coral sand
outcomes.description: Curved beach of pale coral sand with turquoise shallows and a single coastal palm
